correctness.rationale: Open neighborhood cover X=union Delta((A-a_i)+b_i), Y similarly, has each side collapsed onto boundary of an (n-1)-simplex, giving H_{n-2}(X)=H_{n-2}(Y)=Z with permutation orientation sign. X intersect Y is connected crown graph with 2n vertices and n(n-1) oriented edges a_i->b_j i!=j, H1 rank n^2-3n+1 and integral matrix cycles exactly zero row/column sums and zero diagonal. For n>=5 no degree collision; MV gives H2 ≅ H1(crown) and two top classes. Ordered MV boundary δ[x+y]=[∂x] changes sign when layers exchange, while graph layer swap of oriented crown edges induces -M^T; the two signs cancel yielding +M^T integrally. Rational transpose symmetric and skew parts identify Specht S^{(n-2,2)} and S^{(n-2,1,1)}, but this splitting is not asserted integrally. Cellular Lefschetz yields f²-3f+1 and 2t-1, with high-degree trace 2sgn and 0. Independently built the neighborhood complex and checked signed Lefschetz action for 12 automorphisms across n=5,6; all matched. For n=4 degrees collide and theorem explicitly excludes it.
